verdict.rationale: Docs mention a 'developer-first API' with 'auto-generated documentation per workspace' for both GraphQL and REST endpoints (twenty-docs-8), implying some interactive per-workspace API reference, but there is no explicit description of runnable/try-it-out examples, and a probe for a standard OpenAPI/Swagger endpoint at the docs domain returned 404s (inconclusive since it wasn't the per-workspace endpoint). Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of an interactive 'try it out' console, screenshots or docs describing runnable code examples, and independent corroboration that the auto-generated docs are interactive rather than static.
